title: Amplify backend instantiates Auritus SpeechRenderer (own instance)
description: In `web/amplify/backend.ts`, add `new SpeechRenderer(backend.createStack('Voice'), …)` from npm `@anthusai/auritus-construct`, with the Apricity storage bucket as output (prefix `voice-renders/`), `dailyBudgetUsd: 10` and `allowedBackends: ['kokoro']`. Grant start-execution to the voice-request Lambda.

comments.author: home
comments.text: A sandbox deploy failed because the account has hit its VPC and IGW quota (5) in us-east-1; the sandbox is deleted, and per the user no sandbox is needed. Fix: the renderer uses the default VPC vpc-0c653255d9da22015 through APRICITY_VOICE_VPC_ID and APRICITY_VOICE_SUBNETS, set on the Amplify app (merged into the existing variables, none changed). The construct still creates its own VPC by default for other hosts.

right_now_summary: The renderer now uses the default VPC, avoiding a sandbox deploy that exceeded account quotas.
